MAKE DOC: Mending a puncture
## Tools
- Tyre levers
- Puncture repair kit
- Pump
## Method
- Remove the wheel and deflate the inner tube completely.
- Use the levers to lift one bead of the tyre off the rim, then pull the tube out.
- Inflate the tube slightly and listen or feel for escaping air; mark the hole.
- Sand around the hole, apply a thin layer of rubber solution, wait until tacky, and press the patch on.
- Check the inside of the tyre for thorns, refit the tube and tyre, and inflate to the pressure printed on the sidewall.
END
